monetization.noteEs: Compra única (~$60 USD) que incluye el juego completo, sin microtransacciones, sin season pass y sin DLC de pago. Larian distribuyó actualizaciones grandes gratis (hasta Patch 8) que sumaron subclases, modos, cross-play y soporte oficial de mods. Es uno de los pocos AAA recientes sin economía de monetización post-compra.
monetization.noteEn: One-time purchase (~$60 USD) including the full game, with no microtransactions, no season pass, and no paid DLC. Larian shipped large free updates (through Patch 8) adding subclasses, modes, cross-play, and official mod support. It's one of the few recent AAA titles with no post-purchase monetization economy.
